scope: Three sequential reviews of the opt-in per-candidate MAC rotation and affected shared timing/session paths. No subagents, live router changes, builds or deployment.

reviews.focus: Exact upstream native candidate boundary, stage transition and session-save contract.
reviews.confirmed: -g 1 counts a rejected candidate, not each transmitted packet. advance_pin_count changes exactly one active index, and main saves the session after crack returns.
reviews.finding: Lexicographic progress comparison incorrectly admitted impossible index jumps or second-stage regressions.
reviews.fix: native_step mirrors exact +1 updates with allowed stage transition. Saved exhausted sessions do not launch; a last rejection reports range end without relaunch.

reviews.focus: Owned-interface source/channel sequence, cancellation, timing and resource cleanup.

sources.finding: Source-address setter and up/down flags inspected; actual driver readback remains required.
Source-address setter and up/down flags inspected; actual driver readback remains required.

findings: Cancellation after MAC preparation could reach the phase callback without a fresh cancellation check.
A new native phase inherited the previous receive-idle deadline and could prematurely stop while waiting for its first candidate.
fixes: Check cancellation after command preparation and before phase launch in normal and quick paths.
Clear receive liveness at phase boundary and initialize it from the new reported candidate, while retaining candidate change statistics.
Each random draw is checked within a finite eight-draw budget.
Read and validate native progress in one bounded snapshot rather than validate then reopen.

reviews.focus: UI/configuration lifecycle and full affected call chain; default-off, first candidate/restart, quick candidate isolation, timeout, cancellation, failure cleanup and durable sessions.

sources.finding: Disabled state propagates to children; existing master/mode linkage and get_settings behavior checked by Qt tests.

reviews.result: No additional execution-flow defect found after repairs. Existing default-off path and stored manual address preservation passed directed tests.

additional_regressions: Eighth valid random draw accepted without further generation
Quick cancellation after source preparation never launches
Validated progress snapshot opens only once

limitations: No live radio/driver validation or complete WPS exchange was performed. Interface readback is not proof of over-air packet exchange.
No Debian 12 runtime verification; shared Python logic passed tests on this Windows host.
Three reviews and passing tests do not prove absence of every bug.
The already running application must be restarted to load these source fixes.
